description: Check a CHANGE to a saved mission-test config without saving it. Takes the config `id` and only the fields to change (same as the update body; `null` clears description, tags, maxDurationSecs, backgroundNoise, advancedParams or language). Returns the full config as it would be after the change, `changes` (only fields whose value would differ, with before and after), `problems` (every failed check at once) and `version` (the config's current updatedAt). Nothing is saved or changed, so it is safe to call repeatedly. Use when: the user wants to edit a test and you want to show what would change before they save it. Returns 404 if the config does not exist in your workspace. Saving is a separate step the user takes in the app.

anyOf.description:
Optional advanced turn-detection overrides for a single mission test.
Mirrors `api/packages/schemas/entities/missionAdvancedParams.ts` (Zod).
All-or-nothing: every field is required when this object is present —
this is what makes it safe for the values to be sent to Telnyx as a
single per-call block regardless of whether Telnyx merges into or
replaces the stored assistant's turn-detection settings. Omit the
object entirely to keep the server's env-var defaults.

eagerEotThreshold.description:
Lets the assistant start preparing a reply before it is sure the
other side has finished (0.3-0.9). It does not make the assistant
wait longer; `eotThreshold` does. Equal to `eotThreshold` switches
early preparation off.

eotThreshold.description:
The main control: how confident the assistant must be that the
other side has finished speaking before it replies (0.5-0.9). 0.9
waits longest and interrupts least; 0.5 replies at almost any pause.

eotTimeoutMs.description:
The longest the assistant sits through silence, in milliseconds,
before replying anyway. A ceiling, not a minimum wait: raising it
does not stop interruptions.

advancedParams.description:
Per-call turn-detection overrides. Pass `null` to clear it (DDB
REMOVE — same sentinel pattern as `description: null`), which
reverts the config to mission-tester's env-var defaults. Omit the
key to leave the current value unchanged. This is OpenAPI 3.1.0,
so the nullable branch is expressed with `anyOf` + `type: 'null'`
rather than the 3.0 `nullable` keyword (AJV ignores `nullable`
under 3.1 — memory `feedback_ajv_openapi_nullable`).

anyOf.description:
Caller background noise: café chatter, city street traffic, home (children and a
baby crying) or wind buffeting. The level is fixed per sound.

backgroundNoise.description:
Caller background noise played under the call. Pass `null` to remove it
(no noise), or omit the key to leave the current value unchanged.

carrierRouteId.description:
Bring-your-own-carrier (invite-only): the carrier route this config's runs dial through.
Pass `null` to clear it, so runs dial over nopaque's network again. Omit the key to
leave the current value unchanged. Changing `phoneNumber` alone re-checks the new number
against the route already saved.

description.description:
Pass `null` to clear the description attribute (DDB REMOVE).
Omit the key to leave the current value unchanged.

anyOf.description:
The language a mission test call is held in. These are the languages
Telnyx `deepgram/flux` accepts on the AI Assistant: one language, or
`multi` (Flux-multi), which code-switches across the other ten. Absent
means English. Mirrors `api/packages/schemas/entities/callLanguage.ts`
(Zod). Distinct from the transcription languages standard tests and
mapping use (`en-GB` etc.).

language.description:
The call language. Pass `null` to clear it (DDB REMOVE — same sentinel
pattern as `advancedParams`), which reverts the config to English. Omit
the key to leave the current value unchanged.

maxDurationSecs.description:
Per-call duration cap in seconds. Pass `null` to clear it (DDB
REMOVE — same sentinel pattern as `description: null`), which
reverts the config to the server default for its mission kind.
Omit the key to leave the current value unchanged. The null branch
is declared with `anyOf` + `type: 'null'` for the same reason
`advancedParams` below is — see the note there.

scheduleId.description:
The schedule that runs this mission test automatically: a schedule id from the same
workspace, or `template:<template-id>` to create one from a built-in template. Pass
`null` to clear it (manual runs only). Omit the key to leave the current value unchanged.

tags.description:
Lowercase kebab-case tag list (1-32 chars per tag, max 10 tags).
Pass `null` to clear all tags (DDB REMOVE — same sentinel pattern
as `description: null`). Pass `[]` to clear (handler normalises
empty array to null before persisting). Omit the key to leave
existing tags unchanged.

voiceId.description:
Telnyx voice id for the call, from the operator-enabled catalogue
(`GET /testing/voices`). Omit to use the configured default voice.

name: draftMissionTestConfigChange

outputSchema.description: The answer to a draft of a change to a saved mission test config. Nothing is saved.

changes.description: Only the fields whose value would differ from the stored one.

items.description: One field whose value would differ. `null` means the field is (or would be) absent.

config.description:
The full stored config as it would be after the change. Its `updatedAt` is the
current one; a real save would set a new one.

problems.description: Every check that failed. Empty when the change could be saved as sent.

field.description: The field the problem is about (nested paths are joined with `.`).

message.example: phoneNumber must be E.164 (+ then 1-15 digits)

version.description:
The stored config's current `updatedAt`. Pass it as `expectedUpdatedAt` when saving
the change, so a save is refused if the config changed in between.

title: Draft Mission Test Config Change
